titre: Arrivées de touristes internationaux par région

Europe.texte: Europe, the world's largest destination region, recorded 793 million international tourists in 2025, a 4% increase from 2024

Asie-Pacifique.texte: Arrivals in Asia and the Pacific (331 million) grew 6% last year, reaching 91% of the pre-pandemic figure

Amériques.texte: The Americas (218 million) recorded 1% growth last year, with mixed results across subregions.

Moyen-Orient.texte: The region virtually reached the mark of 100 million international visitors.

Afrique.texte: Africa (81 million) saw an 8% increase in arrivals in 2025, with particularly strong results in North Africa (+11%).
